name: 43064 · Plain City, OH
findings: ZIP 43064 (Plain City) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43064 (Plain City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43064 (Plain City) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
